title: TAT-3686 — perps-controller v11 regression proof
description: Drives the perps surfaces that consume @metamask/perps-controller after the ^10.0.0 -> ^11.0.0 bump: perps home, market detail, and the order-entry order-type toggle whose handler signature was widened to the new OrderType union.

proofTargets.claim: Perps home renders controller-backed content under perps-controller v11.
Market detail streams live market data under perps-controller v11.
The order-entry order-type toggle still switches between market and limit after handleOrderTypeClick was widened to the v11 OrderType union.

gate-unlock.intent: Unlock the wallet so perps surfaces can render

ac1-wait-perps-view.intent: C1: perps home renders under perps-controller v11 rather than staying on the loading skeleton

ac1-read-state.intent: C1: read wallet state to confirm the v11 controller is wired into the background

ac1-screenshot-perps-home.label: C1: perps home renders with controller-backed content on v11
ac1-screenshot-perps-home.intent: The perps home screen is on-screen with its markets and activity content, not a loading skeleton

ac2-navigate-market.intent: C2: open the ETH market detail surface

ac2-wait-market-detail.intent: C2: the market price streamed through the v11 controller is visible

ac2-screenshot-market-detail.label: C2: ETH market detail shows a live price and chart on v11
ac2-screenshot-market-detail.intent: The ETH market screen shows a live price and chart to the user

ac3-open-order-entry.intent: C3: open order entry from the market detail long CTA

ac3-wait-order-type-toggle.intent: C3: the order-type toggle renders in order entry

ac3-press-limit.intent: C3: switch the order type to limit through the widened OrderType handler

ac3-wait-limit-price-input.intent: C3: selecting limit reaches usePerpsOrderForm and reveals the limit price input

ac3-screenshot-limit-selected.label: C3: limit order type selected, limit price input visible
ac3-screenshot-limit-selected.intent: The limit pill reads as selected and the limit price field is on-screen for the user

ac3-press-market.intent: C3: switch back to market to prove the handler round-trips both values

ac3-wait-limit-price-hidden.intent: C3: switching back to market hides the limit price input
